text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On a day off, I go to the shopping district to pick up some things and encounter Nice Nature chatting with a shopkeeper.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way home after helping me out with some shopping, she talks sincerely about how the people in the shopping district cheer her on and motivate her to keep going.
